title: Dynastic Storm
next_chapter_hook: In the prince's chamber where the warning was received, the candle flame suddenly flickered out for a moment. When he opened his eyes again, they were filled with murderous intent as cold as frost—'Investigate! Dig through every stone if you must, drag out this meddling insect!'

text.content: The night wind cut like a blade as Chen Ji stood before the window, his fingertips tracing the patterns on the Turtle Shell artifact. Master Mo's whispered parting words still echoed in his ears—'The sacrifice on the fourth page... will cause you to lose what you treasure most.' He closed his eyes and concentrated, the Tianji Record Fragment glowing faintly in the depths of his consciousness, yet revealing no answers. Just then, a completely black messenger pigeon landed on the windowsill, a blood-stained silk ribbon tied around its ankle. 'The Crown Prince is in danger.' Only these three words, yet they caused a sharp cold light to flare in Chen Ji's eyes—the dark piece he'd been positioning for three years had finally reached the moment to close the net.

The Imperial Capital, Daming Hall. The atmosphere at the imperial council meeting was so tense that one could wring water from it. Third Prince Xiao Yu clutched a stack of memorial scrolls, a confident sneer playing on his lips: 'Father, Your Imperial Son possesses ironclad evidence—The Crown Prince has secretly contacted the Northern Border Lords, harboring treasonous intentions!' The eyes of all court officials converged on that solitary figure standing alone in the hall's center. Crown Prince Xiao Yan appeared pallid, yet maintained an unyielding posture. His eyes swept rapidly through the crowd—and there, an insignificant green-robed scholar was subtly nodding.

dialogue.content: (Low bowing his head, voice carrying clearly to the Crown Prince's ears) 'Your Highness, do not panic. I have already arranged a contingency. His Royal Highness the Third Prince's 'ironclad evidence' is merely a forged replica. The true evidence lies in his sleeve—that Northern Border Lord's private seal is the key to breaking this situation.'

text.content: Xiao Yu sensed something wrong. His eyes narrowed, scanning the ministers with suspicion, yet detecting nothing unusual. He coldly snorted, raising the memorial high: 'Father, please observe—this is correspondence between the Crown Prince and the Northern Border, and also—' Before he could finish, chaos erupted outside the hall. A military commander rushed in, kneeling and announcing loudly: 'Your Majesty! During the investigation of assassins, this official discovered a Northern Border Lord's private seal in the Third Prince's chambers, along with dozens of forged letters!'

The court erupted in stunned murmurs. Xiao Yu's memorial nearly slipped from his fingers as his face turned ashen: 'This... this is clearly a frame-up!' The emperor sat upon the dragon throne, his gaze deep and penetrating as it swept across his sons. After a long pause, he finally spoke: 'Yu'er, I ask you—if this seal is genuine, how do you explain yourself?' Chen Ji continued to bow his head, a subtle smile curling his lips. Three years ago when he had set his pieces in the capital, he had planted this chess piece beside Xiao Yu, and tonight it had finally proven useful.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's crisis has been temporarily resolved, but the evidence of the Third Prince's rebellion has fallen into the emperor's hands. How will you proceed?

choices.text: Press the advantage and submit another secret memorial
choices.description: Present the intelligence about the Third Prince's secret dealings with the Xuanwu Sect simultaneously, thoroughly cutting off his chance of a comeback.
choices.visible_cost: Leverage the Crown Prince to owe you a favor
choices.visible_reward: The Third Prince is utterly ruined, the court landscape reshaped
choices.risk_hint: Actions too bold will alert the emperor and expose traces of your covert manipulations

text.content: In the name of a guest advisor to the 'Crown Prince's Grand Tutor,' Chen Ji quietly submitted a sealed memorial. The emperor opened it, his dragon eyes narrowing sharply—the document detailed the Third Prince's secret communications with Xuanwu Sect elders, even involving the imperial city's military rotation schedules. Xiao Yu's doom had finally and completely arrived.

After the court session, Crown Prince Xiao Yan deliberately took a circuitous route, 'coincidentally' encountering the green-robed scholar on the palace corridor. He deeply bowed: 'Your great kindness, Xiao Yan will forever remember in my heart.' Chen Ji returned the gesture, his voice flat: 'Your Highness overstates it, this minister merely follows orders.' As he turned to leave, his gaze turned deep and unfathomable—Xiao Yu was not enough.

choices.text: Quietly withdraw and conduct a thorough investigation behind the Third Prince
choices.description: The Third Prince is merely a chess piece; the true opponent is someone else entirely. You need to follow this trail to uncover the mastermind.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the opportunity to expand your achievements
choices.visible_reward: Discover the hidden connection between the humiliation of the broken engagement and the internal machinations of the dynasty
choices.risk_hint: The hidden forces may strike preemptively once they sense your investigation

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to act. He quietly activated the Tianji Record, foreseeing the Third Prince Xiao Yu's reactions within the next three hours—as expected, driven by fear, the first thing he did was send someone to a secluded mansion in the eastern part of the city. 'Interesting.' Chen Ji's gaze narrowed slightly. The true owner of that mansion was precisely that noble who had stirred up trouble during the incident of Chen Ji's broken engagement—the nephew of Consort De, mother of the Sixth Prince Xiao Yan.

choices.description: Without anyone knowing, demonstrate to the Third Prince that you are aware of all his secrets. Let him languish in fear.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the enemy and provoke a desperate revenge
choices.visible_reward: The Third Prince will从此对你产生心理阴影，成为日后翻盘的伏笔
choices.risk_hint: If they find out it was you, the consequences would be unthinkable

text.content: That night, Third Prince Xiao Yu discovered a note in his study. There was only one line written on it: 'The singing girl Your Highness favored last night is a spy planted by the Xuanwu Sect. Your subject is aware. I hope Your Highness will conduct himself wisely.' Xiao Yu's hair stood on end, the note in his hand nearly crumpled to pieces—who was this 'subject'? How did they know everything?

Chen Ji returned to the secret hideout outside the Tianqing Sect that very night, pushing open the door to the hidden chamber. The walls were covered with countless threads of investigation—Third Prince, Sixth Prince, Consort De, Xuanwu Sect... red lines crisscrossed into a web, and at the very center were two stark characters: Cancellation of Betrothal. He retrieved a yellowed marriage contract from his chest, a document from five years ago when the Chen family suffered disaster, forcing his younger sister Chen Nian to take her sister's place in marriage. 'Xiao Yan... no, I should call you cousin.' Chen Ji murmured softly, the chill in his gaze deepening.

It turned out the Chen family and the imperial family had a long-standing marriage pact—Chen Ji's father and the late emperor were childhood friends, agreeing their next generation would marry. But after the Chen family's fall from grace, this marriage became taboo. The Sixth Prince's mother, Consort De, was precisely Chen Ji's mother's cousin. She feared this marriage would surface and impact her son's succession ambitions, so she secretly orchestrated the arrangement, not only annulling the betrothal but also abducting Chen Nian and faking her 'disappearance'. Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: 'My dear cousin probably still doesn't realize what sins his mother has committed.'

dialogue.content: (Fingers tapping lightly on the desk, flames of fury burning deep in his eyes) Nian Nian... where are you? Where did Consort De's people take you? Five years, I've been plotting for five years, finally pulling the threads to your side. This time, I won't let anyone take you away from me again.

choice.prompt: Consort De and Sixth Prince Xiao Lin's power runs far deeper than you could imagine. Faced with this enemy who indirectly caused your sister's disappearance and burdened you with the humiliation of betrothal cancellation, how do you decide to act?

choices.text: Directly present evidence to the Sixth Prince
choices.description: Let Xiao Lin know his mother's hands are stained with the Chen family's blood. Fratricide is the best revenge.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing your connection to the Chen family may bring danger to your life
choices.visible_reward: The Sixth Prince turns against Consort De, internal royal struggle intensifies
choices.risk_hint: If the Sixth Prince doesn't believe you, it will only alert the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji, under the guise of a 'recluse from the martial world', arranged to meet the Sixth Prince at the Ten-Mile Pavilion outside the city walls. He laid out before Xiao Lin the original marriage contract, the betrothal annulment documents, and the secret letters exchanged between Consort De and the black-clad figures. The young prince's face turned ashen, his hands trembling: 'Who... who exactly are you?' Chen Ji rose to his feet, his back to the prince: 'Your Highness need not know who I am. You only need to know—your mother killed your cousin.'

choices.text: Set a trap to make Consort De lose her composure
choices.description: Spread false information to induce Consort De to make mistakes. When she reveals her hand, present the evidence to the Emperor.
choices.visible_cost: Requires more time to set up, may miss the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Consort De is ordered to die, the Sixth Prince loses power due to association
choices.risk_hint: Consort De has cultivated her position in the palace for years, her foundation is deep and not easily shaken

text.content: Chen Ji quietly leaked a piece of information: someone was investigating the old Chen family case. Consort De predictably took the bait—her assassins had barely left the palace gates when Chen Ji's planted informant relayed the news to the Emperor. In imperial fury, Consort De was sent to the cold palace, and the Sixth Prince was ordered to confine himself for reflection. 'This is just an appetizer.' Chen Ji said coolly, 'Once I find Nian Nian, I'll settle accounts with them properly.'

choices.text: Temporarily hold your position and search for Chen Nian in secret
choices.description: Revenge can wait, but my sister cannot. Find Chen Nian's whereabouts first, everything else can wait until later.
choices.visible_cost: Consort De might seize the opportunity to turn the tables
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about Chen Nian, reunion of siblings becomes hopeful
choices.risk_hint: Clues may point to an even more terrifying truth

text.content: Chen Ji gathered all the evidence and turned to leave the capital. He activated the Tianji Record, attempting to foresee Chen Nian's location—but the vision was a blur, only vague shadows flickering before his eyes. Heavenly Fate Lock Key... Chen Nian's existence itself was interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight. But this time, he had a new lead: Consort De had been in contact with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. 'Could it be...' Chen Ji's heart tightened. If his sister truly fell into the hands of the Demonic Path, matters would become far more complicated.

As Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, another door in the hidden chamber swung open. A graceful figure slipped inside—it was Ye Qing, the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path. Clad in black纱, her eyes carried a hint of solemnity: 'Chen Ji, I've found something.' She handed over a blood-stained Jade Pendant, 'This is an internal code of the Holy Sect—someone is conducting a secret plan called the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'. And the location under guard lies deep within the Northern Ice Plains.'

dialogue.content: (Eyes slightly lowered, voice low) I was used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect for many years. Now that I'm cooperating with you, I won't hold back. But I must remind you—the Northern Frontier Ice Plain is the periphery of the Ancient Forbidden Land, where an ancient fierce beast lurks. Even the Sect Master of my Holy Sect dares not enter lightly. If you insist on going... I can provide some assistance, but you know the price.

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Pendant, his fingertips tracing the mottled bloodstains. This was Ye Qing's oath of allegiance—she betrays the Holy Sect to provide him intelligence, in exchange for a promise in the future. He tucked the Jade Pendant into his chest, his gaze falling on Ye Qing's face: "Ye Saint Maiden, although we're cooperating for mutual benefit, I will remember this kindness today." Ye Qing's lips curved slightly, revealing a meaningful smile: "I don't need you to remember kindness. I only hope that in the future... you can help me escape the Holy Sect's control." The two exchanged glances, and a certain tacit understanding formed in secret.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing is willing to help you go to the Northern Frontier Ice Plain, but her conditions remain unclear. Meanwhile, you have received a secret letter from Crown Prince Xiao Yan, inviting you to the palace in three days for "old times' sake." Imperial Capital or Northern Frontier—you must make a choice.

choices.text: First fulfill the Crown Prince's appointment and stabilize the court situation
choices.description: The Northern Frontier journey is extremely dangerous; before departure, you must ensure the Imperial Capital's layout isn't disrupted. The Crown Prince is your most important chess piece and cannot be lost.
choices.visible_cost: Delaying for several days might miss the best opportunity to rescue Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Gain more trust and resource support from the Crown Prince to provide backup for the Northern Frontier journey
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince might discover your true identity

text.content: Chen Ji decided to stabilize the Crown Prince first. Three days later, he entered the palace as a guest of the "Crown Prince's Mentor." Xiao Yan dismissed all attendants and personally poured tea for him: "Sir, you saved me in crisis. This prince has no way to repay you. If Sir has any needs in the future, Xiao Yan would die without hesitation." Chen Ji took the teacup, his gaze flickering—this Crown Prince understood gratitude better than he imagined. Perhaps it was time to tell him some truths.

choices.text: Set off immediately for the Northern Frontier
choices.description: Chen Nian's news has waited five years and can no longer be delayed. The Crown Prince's matter can be dealt with later.
choices.visible_cost: May offend the Crown Prince and lose an important chess piece in the Imperial Capital
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Nian's exact location at the earliest possible moment
choices.risk_hint: The Northern Frontier is extremely dangerous; going alone means nine deaths in ten chances

text.content: Chen Ji left the city that night and, after meeting with Ye Qing, rushed directly to the Northern Frontier. Along the way, he was silent, only in the deep night, alone gazing at the southern stars murmuring: "Nian Nian, big brother is coming." Ye Qing watched, her heart stirring slightly—this seemingly cold and calculating man had such a soft side. Seven days later, the two finally arrived at the edge of the Northern Frontier Ice Plain, where a majestic ice palace stood amidst wind and snow.

choices.description: Before leaving, deliver a "gift" to the Third Prince Xiao Yu that will make him lose sleep and appetite. Let him know that there are eyes watching him.
choices.visible_cost: Dividing energy may delay other plans
choices.visible_reward: The Third Prince will live in fear from now on, laying groundwork for a comeback later
choices.risk_hint: Movements too large will expose your existence

text.content: Chen Ji infiltrated the Third Prince's mansion again. This time he didn't leave a note. Instead, he placed a "gift" right beside Xiao Yu's pillow—a Jade Pendant carved with the Chen Family Emblem, identical to the betrothal token the Chen Family was forced to surrender during the broken engagement back then. When Xiao Yu woke up and saw the Jade Pendant, he rolled off the bed in fright, shouting "Assassin!" loud repeatedly! However, the guards searched the entire mansion and found nothing. Chen Ji had already vanished in the morning light, leaving only legends behind.

After handling Imperial Capital affairs, Chen Ji finally had peace of mind to organize his thoughts. He sat alone in the study, the Tianji Record Fragment spread before him, Mo Xiansheng's phantom faintly visible. "Master, what exactly is the sacrifice condition for the fourth page?" There was no answer on the fragment, only an ancient line of text glowing faintly: "To obtain Heavenly Secrets, first lose your own life." Chen Ji closed his eyes, and his sister Chen Nian's face appeared in his mind—if the price of sacrifice was losing her, he would rather never see Heavenly Secrets for eternity.

Night wind crept through the window cracks, stirring the candle flame on the desk. Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, a flash of精光 in his gaze—the Tianji Record operated autonomously, foreseeing a blurry future: In three days, the Northern Frontier Ice Plain will encounter a once-in-a-century storm.届时冰宫的防御formation会出现短暂的漏洞。而在那风暴的中心，有一道熟悉的生命气息正在微弱地脉动。「念念……」陈机霍然起身，双手紧握成拳。无论要付出什么代价，他都要去北境。"Nian Nian..." Chen Ji rose abruptly, hands clenched into fists. Whatever the cost, he must go to the Northern Frontier.

Meanwhile, in a certain hidden courtyard in the Imperial City, the Sixth Prince Xiao Lin was sitting across from his mother, Consort De. Consort De's face was haggard, clutching a shattered jade talisman: "Lin'er, that matter... Mother has already taken care of it cleanly. No one will ever know." Xiao Lin was silent for a long while, then suddenly spoke: "Mother, what you did to the Chen Family back then... is cousin Chen Ji still alive?" Consort De's face changed dramatically: "Where did you hear this?" Xiao Lin didn't answer, only gave his mother a deep look, then turned and left. For the first time, there was turbulence and doubt in his eyes.

And in a more distant place—deep within the forbidden grounds at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the old Sect Master Ling Yuan was murmuring before an ancient mirror. Reflected in the mirror was Chen Ji's figure as he arranged things in the Imperial Capital. A cold, sinister smile appeared on Ling Yuan's aged face: "The inheritor of the Tianji Record... did you think you were hiding well?" He waved his hand across the mirror's surface, and Chen Ji's figure immediately became crystal clear, even the direction he was looking at being perfectly visible. "Let you scramble for a few more days. Once I've completely controlled this 'Mirror of Heavenly Dao,' it will be your death day."

Chen Ji was unaware that he was being watched. At this moment, he stood outside the city gate, the rising sun at his back. Pressed against his chest was the Northern Border map given by Ye Qing, and hanging from his waist was a Demonic Path artifact capable of concealing the aura of the Tianji Record—everything was in place. However, just as he was about to take his first step, urgent hoofbeats sounded behind him. A black-clad figure dismounted his horse and knelt on one knee: "Young Master Chen, urgent message from His Highness the Crown Prince—Third Prince Xiao Yu has gone mad! He has mobilized the hidden operatives of Xuanwu Sect, and they're heading straight for your location!"

Chen Ji's footsteps faltered, yet a smile actually curled at the corner of his lips. The Third Prince's counterattack had come so quickly—it seemed the 'gift' he'd sent had achieved excellent results. He turned to look at the black-clad figure: "Where is the Third Prince now?" The figure replied: "On the official road thirty li outside the city. He's gathered over a hundred disciples from Xuanwu Sect, declaring he intends to capture 'that meddling thief' alive." Chen Ji laughed lightly, hands clasped behind his back: "Interesting. Since that's the case, then I'll go meet this old acquaintance." He strode forward, the morning sun stretching his shadow long. "Nian Nian, your brother will first clear away some troublesome flies, then come find you."
